settings.description: Internal resolution per axis, in thousandths (500 = half width and height, a quarter of the pixels). Lower relieves the GPU; a few games draw wrong at lower scales. Unreal Engine games default to 25 % unless the game has its own value.
Compile shaders in the background. Avoids stutter; an object may take a moment to appear. Off compiles every pipeline before drawing.
Shadow map size in thousandths, independent of the internal resolution. Lower is faster; shadows get softer or blockier. No effect on engines that draw shadows with compute (Unreal Engine 5).
Inverted switch: 1 (default) never forces early depth tests; 0 lets the GPU skip hidden pixels before shading. 0 is faster with heavy overdraw; on some Adreno drivers objects vanish in small blocks.
Fold guest addresses beyond a 39-bit host address space. Off breaks games that map memory there.
Let CPU reads proceed while GPU-written pages download, when they are clear of GPU-written bytes. Off makes every access to those pages wait for the GPU.
Render AudioOut2 objects through OpenAL Soft (3D audio objects).
AudioOut2: commit a grain on a push without a reservation, as before the fix, for games that push without advancing.
Keep recording queued graphics batches into one command buffer. Off flushes after every batch (Unity games then reload render targets often).
Shrink the huge fixed memory reservations of Unreal Engine 4/5 to fit a 39-bit host address space. Off makes those games fail to start.
Emulate depth-compare sampling of color textures with gather and sample. Off keeps the undefined native compare (older behaviour).
Run plain buffer fills (Unreal Engine 4 color metadata keys) on the CPU. Off runs them on the GPU, and later CPU reads wait for it.
Defer the global barrier of release labels inside a render pass instead of ending the pass. Off ends the pass (UE4 split its depth passes per occlusion query).
Barrier after draws whose shaders write memory: 2 defers and tracks written ranges (default), 1 defers blindly (flicker in Stray), 0 ends the pass after each such draw.
Copy between depth and matching color images directly (Vulkan maintenance8) instead of through a buffer. Off always uses the buffer path.
Adreno fix: clear one depth pixel before a pass that starts with a depth-writing ALWAYS draw, which otherwise loses its depth writes (fog-coloured trails).
Size of the guest's direct memory in MiB (PS5 has 13824). Read once at start.
Reuse the copy of a CPU-written buffer made earlier in the same draw window instead of copying it again. Less copying in buffer-heavy games; reusing too widely broke geometry in Asterix XXL2.
Use the feedback-loop layout when draws alternate between sampling and writing depth/stencil, instead of ending the pass at every draw. Off splits the pass (slower).
Submit the queue after every release label, not only those that raise an interrupt. Costs a blocking submit per Unreal Engine 4 fence on Adreno.
Global barriers on partial flush events. Off is experimental (KytyPS5 dropped them).
Flush F32 denormal shader inputs as RDNA does. Costs a compare and select per operand.
Exact NaN and signed-zero handling of shader min/max.
Track GPU progress with one fence per submission on its own thread instead of timeline semaphores. Helps Turnip on KGSL, where timelines cost about 3 ms per submission.
Detect the host CPU's features for the x86 translator. Off uses a fixed list.
Declare signed zero, infinity and NaN preservation in shaders. Off lets the driver use fast math.
Pin the emulator's GPU thread to the cores with the highest maximum clock. Off leaves it to the scheduler.
Read indirect draw arguments on the GPU. Off reads them on the CPU.
Track descriptors of writable shaders without a GPU phi. Off restores the phi for every descriptor (older, slower, for shaders that bind the wrong resource).
Run some HLE functions as guest code instead of traps. Off keeps every HLE function a trap (slower).
Cache small guest memory reads per thread.
Treat only a write of exactly the live HTile range as a depth metadata clear. Default PS5 games; Off is the old rule (can hang the GPU or leave buffers unfilled); PS4 sizes are estimated.
Download GPU-written images before the CPU reads their memory. Fixes effects the CPU computes from GPU output (black indirect lighting in Unreal Engine 4); costs GPU waits.
Inside a render pass, serve CPU-modified read-only buffers from the stream ring instead of ending the pass to sync them. Avoids lost depth writes on Adreno (Dead Cells walls).
Keep a depth image's current attachment layout when the draw's writes allow it, avoiding layout changes that end the pass.
How shaders discard pixels: 0 OpKill, 1 OpTerminateInvocation, 2 OpDemoteToHelperInvocation.
Loop iterations a compute dispatch may spend in all, before loops are cut to stay under the driver's timeout.
Loop iterations per shader invocation of small dispatches and graphics stages before the loop is cut.
Merge attachment and shader-read access inside a render pass instead of emitting barriers that end it. Off emits the barriers (slower).
Fold register-index comparisons in shaders (constant propagation). Off keeps the comparisons, for shaders that compute wrong after folding.
NGS2 audio: count the ATRAC9 decoder delay. Off parses ATRAC9 blocks as before the fix (no delay, fact chunk's delay and skip).
NGS2 audio: a custom mastering voice without an Output module writes its first buffer (default). Off leaves it silent.
NGS2 audio: apply the sampler filters. Off ignores them, as the old layout mostly did.
NGS2 audio: apply the mastering limiter. Off leaves the output unlimited, as before the limiter.
NGS2 audio: play 1 + num_repeats passes of a block, as before the fix (default plays max(1, num_repeats)).
NGS2 audio: hand out the last voice for an out-of-range voice index instead of returning an error, as before the fix.
Do not use the driver's fragment barycentrics; use the fallback. For Turnip builds on Adreno 8xx whose compiler fails on them.
Report a 4K display to the game instead of 1080p. Games that size rendering from the output then render about four times the pixels; only for games that need a 4K output.
Reuse a render pass's fresh buffer copy for later draws of the pass. Fewer copies; wrong when data changes between draws (vanishing buildings in Asterix XXL2).
Half-pixel shift for D3D9-style pixel centers: 0 follows the game's register, 1 never shifts, 2 always shifts.
Back off after failed event-flag polls. Off lets those polls spin (more CPU).
Prefetch pipelines for queued graphics submissions.
KiB of GPU-written buffer to download after a faulting CPU read (0 = only the faulting pages).
Skip texture and render-target resolves whose source and registers did not change (PS5 games only). Less GPU work in games that repeat the same resolves.
Render pass clears on Adreno: 3 opens with LOAD and clears inside (default), 0 loadOp CLEAR, 1 keeps the pass when only clears change, 2 clears in a pass of its own.
Sample images in the GENERAL layout. Wrong mips on the stock Adreno driver (blurry, blocky textures); Turnip was fine.
Downscale full-screen compute grids with the resolution scale. Experimental; no tested game qualified.
Size of the per-draw stream ring in MiB (read at start). Larger can reduce GPU waits; 128+ broke geometry in Asterix XXL2.

Release GPU suspend points once every earlier packet is submitted, without waiting for the host GPU, so the game's CPU can run up to a frame ahead. Fewer CPU waits; late texture downloads could land in reused memory. Unmeasured, off by default.
GPU timestamps advance N times faster, so games that size rendering from GPU time see a slower GPU.

Emulate x86 TSO memory ordering for guest loads and stores (on by default). Turning it off makes CPU emulation faster but breaks lock-free code: Unreal Engine games crash in their task graph. Only suggest off for a non-Unreal game that is CPU-bound and known to be stable without it.
Wait for the whole GPU before memory the GPU used is unmapped. Off (default) waits only for GPU-written data; on is the older, slow behaviour (Monster Boy at 14 FPS).
Microseconds the GPU thread waits for a label before logging and moving on.
KiB window released around a CPU write fault on a buffer (4 = one page, power of two).
Microseconds to sleep after a burst of guest yields (Unreal polls with millions). 0 keeps sched_yield; a short sleep can free the core and power budget.
